opportunities.title: Munchkin Goes 5E: What Happens When a Card Game Inherits D&D's Chassis
opportunities.why_now: EN World just broke that Munchkin is becoming a 5E-powered RPG, a direct crossover of rules systems worth dissecting.
opportunities.angle: Rules breakdown: predict how Munchkin's absurdist mechanics (curses, bonuses, backstabbing) will be translated into 5E's action economy and classes; call out likely friction points

opportunities.title: Castle Ravenloft's Reprint Is a Reminder D&D Already Wrote the Rules for Board-Gaming Itself
opportunities.why_now: Renegade Games just announced the reprint, giving an easy hook to revisit how Castle Ravenloft's tile-and-power-card system pre-solved problems modern 5E hombrewers still fight over.
opportunities.angle: Rules-history piece: trace which Ravenloft mechanics (skill checks, monster AI, treasure decks) got absorbed or ignored by later 5E design

opportunities.title: Junkpunk's Rules Are Already Written, Just in Salvage Metal Instead of Vellum
opportunities.why_now: EN World's RPG Evolution column spotlighted Junkpunk this week, and the genre's scavenging/crafting mechanics are ripe for a rules-first teardown.
opportunities.angle: System analysis: compare Junkpunk's improvised-gear rules to established crafting subsystems (5E, Mothership, Numenera) and rate which solved the 'junk economy' problem best

opportunities.title: Sly Flourish's 'Procedures' Is the Rulebook Every DM Screen Should Have Printed on It
opportunities.why_now: Sly Flourish just published a fresh breakdown of GM procedures, a perfect match for a channel built on 'the rules are already written.'
opportunities.angle: Response/annotation post: take Sly Flourish's procedure list and cross-reference it against actual 5E/2024 rulebook text to show what's official vs. house-invented

opportunities.title: Pitching a Campaign Isn't Improv — Gnomecast Just Gave You the Rulebook for It
opportunities.why_now: Gnomecast's new episode on pitching campaigns lands as a structured, rules-adjacent topic that fits the channel's 'knowing' voice perfectly.
opportunities.angle: Turn the podcast's advice into a numbered 'Session Zero Pitch Checklist' framed as codified procedure, with direct callouts to episode timestamps
